title: Almost all simple lengths are unique up to isometry
summary: For every fixed hyperbolic torus with one cusp or one geodesic boundary, we prove that, among simple curves of length at most $L$, the number of isometry orbits and the number of distinct lengths differ by $o(L^2)$. Thus almost every complete length level is a single isometry orbit of at most six curves, and multiplicity converges in mean to the generic orbit size. The modular specialization is exactly Chen's density theorem for Markoff uniqueness.
